description: evidentia runtime enforcement — turns three prose invariants into enforced behavior: (1) PreToolUse guard denies pipeworx-generic + D1/D2/D6 broken MCP tools with a redirect (least-privilege / G-WHITELIST + broken-tool avoidance); (2) PostToolUse reminds retrieve-don't-dump on large full-text output (evidence_index); (3) SessionStart flags any missing gated-connector key (credential-free preflight, silent when all present). All command hooks are deterministic and fail-open. Disable the guard with <project>/.claude/evidentia-guard.off.
